intended_analysis: Compare reaction times across subjects and stimulus types; analyze accuracy by stimulus type using logistic regression

what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong: A naive reader would fail to parse the RT column correctly due to mixed decimal precision and the ~ prefix. They might treat the blank row as actual data or misalign subject boundaries. They might interpret 'Yes'/'No' as ordinal rather than binary.
